series: Gartner Top Strategic Predictions (Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users)

entries.quote: By 2012, 20 percent of businesses will own no IT assets.
entries.subject: Businesses owning no IT assets
entries.metric: share of businesses owning no IT assets

entries.quote: By 2012, India-centric IT services companies will represent 20 percent of the leading cloud aggregators in the market (through cloud service offerings).
entries.subject: India-centric cloud aggregators
entries.metric: share of leading cloud aggregators that are India-centric IT services companies

entries.quote: By 2012, Facebook will become the hub for social network integration and Web socialization.
entries.subject: Facebook as social integration hub

entries.quote: By 2014, most IT business cases will include carbon remediation costs.
entries.subject: Carbon costs in IT business cases
entries.metric: share of IT business cases with carbon remediation costs

entries.quote: In 2012, 60 percent of a new PC's total life greenhouse gas emissions will have occurred before the user first turns the machine on.
entries.subject: PC embodied greenhouse gas emissions
entries.metric: share of PC lifetime emissions before first use

entries.quote: Internet marketing will be regulated by 2015, controlling more than $250 billion in Internet marketing spending worldwide.
entries.subject: Internet marketing regulation

entries.quote: By 2014, over 3 billion of the world's adult population will be able to transact electronically via mobile or Internet technology.
entries.subject: Electronic transactions access

entries.quote: By 2015, context will be as influential to mobile consumer services and relationships as search engines are to the Web.
entries.subject: Context-aware mobile services

entries.quote: By 2013, mobile phones will overtake PCs as the most common Web access device worldwide.
entries.subject: Mobile vs PC web access

notes: Edition covers '2010 and beyond'. Gartner's stated count: not stated (press release states no count of top predictions (it says the 2010 Predicts series has around 250 predictions in 56 areas)). Found in public source: 9 top predictions. Client report: "Gartner's Top Predictions for IT Organizations and Users, 2010 and Beyond: A New Balance" (paywalled). gartner.com returns 403 to scripted fetches; text read from the Internet Archive snapshot listed in sources. First of two editions published in calendar 2010. File named 2010-01. Quotes are the prediction headline sentences as printed in the press release; body text is not stored.
